abstract: The benchmark artifact this campaign optimizes. A single-GPU decoder-only transformer trained under a fixed charged-training-seconds budget and scored in validation bits per byte. The architectural facts cited by this campaign's claims are read directly from the pinned source rather than from a description of it: GPTConfig.window_pattern defaults to 'SSSL'; GPT._compute_window_sizes sets short_window = long_window // 2 and forces the final layer to full context; attention is flash-attention-3 with an explicit window_size; and prepare.py fixes TIME_BUDGET = 300 seconds, which is what makes optimizer steps rather than epochs the currency of the benchmark. Sealed locally as runs/code/upstream/train.py with digests in runs/code/provenance.json.

title: karpathy/autoresearch — reference nanochat-style pretraining benchmark (train.py, prepare.py)
